locations_used.figures_9_and_10: published Section 3.5, Figure 9/10 captions, and Equation (1)

acs_mri_velocity_sign_result.classification: PARTIAL — only some stages are supported
acs_mri_velocity_sign_result.evidence: Author-binned Figure 5/6 velocity maps encode the opposite-sign regions, but the full all-star selection and binning cannot be independently rebuilt.

change_binning.classification: NO — required source information is absent
change_binning.evidence: The Figure 5/6 products are already-binned arrays and contain no source rows or bin edges.

change_minimum_count_thresholds.classification: NO — required source information is absent
change_minimum_count_thresholds.evidence: Counts per velocity/metallicity bin are not released, so NaN masks cannot be recalculated at another threshold.

change_source_level_selections.classification: NO — required source information is absent
change_source_level_selections.evidence: The image products do not contain stellar rows or upstream selection columns.

figure_13_vr_sign_split.classification: YES — directly supported by released data
figure_13_vr_sign_split.evidence: The 7,708-row table contains per-row l, b, V_Z, and V_R, allowing the paper longitude and V_R-sign subsets to be applied.

figures_5_6_style_products.classification: YES — directly supported by released data
figures_5_6_style_products.evidence: The release contains fixed 2-D arrays for the Figure 5 and 6 panels, with header/paper semantics.

photometric_acs_boundary.classification: NO — required source information is absent
photometric_acs_boundary.evidence: The Pan-STARRS count array is released, but the fitted parabola coefficients, fit points/procedure, and boundary/width vectors are not.

independent_fourier_transform.classification: PARTIAL — only some stages are supported
independent_fourier_transform.evidence: The binned wave and errors are present, but the required resampling/interpolation and FFT preprocessing/normalization are undocumented.

lz_vr_wave.classification: YES — directly supported by released data
lz_vr_wave.evidence: Figure 9 releases 70 L_Z-bin coordinates, V_R summaries, and V_R uncertainties.

paper_assumptions.classification: PARTIAL — only some stages are supported
paper_assumptions.evidence: The paper supplies the circular-curve form/slope, epicycle approximation, corotating tidal-arm mapping, Equation (1), V0, R0, Monte-Carlo count, and the interpretation of Fourier frequencies as winding times.

published_fourier_peaks.classification: PARTIAL — only some stages are supported
published_fourier_peaks.evidence: The released Figure 10 spectrum supports grid-level peak localization, but Gaussian fit samples/windows and fitted centers/widths are absent.

timing_conversion.classification: YES — directly supported by released data
timing_conversion.evidence: Published Equation (1), n=0, V0=239.26 km/s, R0=8.277 kpc, and the quoted peak frequencies reproduce about 0.24 and 1.08 Gyr before rounding.

transform_to_inverse_lz.classification: YES — directly supported by released data
transform_to_inverse_lz.evidence: Every released L_Z coordinate is finite and nonzero, so 1/L_Z is an exact data re-expression.

figure_10.independent_fft: Blocked for exact reproduction: Figure 9 supplies the binned wave, but the paper does not specify resampling/interpolation from uniform L_Z to nonuniform 1/L_Z, FFT normalization/window/detrending, or the Monte-Carlo seed/statistic consistently.
figure_10.representation: 35-row author-computed spectrum on a descending, uniformly spaced frequency grid; not Fourier inputs.
figure_10.uncertainties: Power spread is released, but Gaussian peak centers/widths and their fit covariance are not columns.

figure_13.limits: No source identifier, distance, selection flags, weights, uncertainties, photometry, metallicity, or photometric ACS boundary coefficients are released in this table.
figure_13.row_representation: Individual rows from the authors' already-selected MSTO anticenter sample with heliocentric distance >10 kpc; not binned values and not the full DR2 source catalogue.
figure_13.sign_experiment: The all-stars -> V_R>0 -> V_R<0 split can be independently recomputed for the paper longitude bins from the released columns.
figure_13.vr_availability: V_R is present per row; author-produced sign-subset labels are not stored.

figure_14.limits: The photometric boundary/width overlays are absent, as are per-star uncertainties and upstream selection variables.
figure_14.row_representation: Uses the same individual selected-star table as Figure 13.
figure_14.vz_availability: V_Z is present per row, so all/+V_Z/-V_Z subsets can be recomputed for the two published longitude bins.

figure_9.lz_or_inverse_lz: L_Z is released; 1/L_Z is not a column but can be computed exactly from released L_Z values.
figure_9.paper_conflict: Figure 9 caption says mean, 70 bins, 1400--4500; body says median, 75 bins, 2000--4500. Release has 70 rows with centers 1500--4457.142857 in steps of 42.857143.
figure_9.representation: 70 uniformly spaced L_Z-bin summary rows; not individual stars and not a Fourier-ready uniformly spaced 1/L_Z series.
figure_9.uncertainties: One V_R uncertainty per bin is released; the paper identifies it as standard error on the mean.

generation.determinism: No generation timestamp or filesystem-dependent path is recorded; sorted JSON output is byte-deterministic for fixed inputs and software.

archive.preservation: Inspected read-only and unchanged; extraction is optional and ignored.
